reuse.why: Edits the existing getScheduledAmount helper and keeps using the shared getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic duplicated; the range and approximate rules are each a one-line change in the single helper.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the expected-amount definition lives.

scope.why: Helper, its doc comment, unit tests and a release note only.

maintainability.why: Simpler than before (Math.min, subtract threshold) with documented and tested semantics.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All callers keep going through getScheduledAmount.
